title: Comparison of the Efficacy of Artificial Intelligence-Powered Software in Crown Design: An In Vitro Study.
summary: 33 real posterior crown scans; standard was an experienced technician’s chairside-adjusted and rescanned crown; AI Automate and Dentbird compared with novice/experienced CAD by time and 3D RMS; AI markedly cut design time, but Dentbird occlusal morphology was less accurate. Catalog title search found no same study. In 33 patient-derived crown cases, AI CAD software shortened design time relative to technician CAD; a clinician-adjusted crown served as reference, and one AI product had worse occlusal morphology. This is a specific dental restoration design result, not evidence of patient benefit.
